reason: The cited evidence confirms that related HEAs are BCS-type phonon-mediated superconductors in the weak-coupling limit (E1) and that HEAs can be conventional BCS superconductors (E2), but it does not provide specific support for the premises that disorder smears the transition, that annealing reduces disorder without changing electron count, or that reduced disorder enhances Tc and sharpens the transition.
premises: Superconductivity in the selected HEA is BCS-type phonon-mediated with weak electron-phonon coupling.
The as-cast state has high configurational disorder that smears electronic states and broadens the superconducting transition.
Thermal annealing reduces atomic-scale disorder without altering electron count.
Reducing disorder enhances electron-phonon coupling efficiency and Cooper pair coherence, raising Tc and sharpening the transition.
